permdock codemod: Apply a release's renames to files that import permdock; list call sites to edit by hand

Usage  permdock codemod <version> [paths...] [flags]

Arguments
  version  The release to migrate to (0.5), config with --prune, manager-chain or bsb-access-tags
  paths    Files or directories to rewrite (default the working directory)

Flags
  --dry-run  Print what would change; write nothing
  --force    Rewrite files with uncommitted changes too
  --prune    With config: remove each key set to its default, after proving every generated file stays the same
  --check    With config --prune: exit 1 when a key would be removed

Global flags
  --cwd --config --json --format --yes --effects-digest --agent --debug --color --help; see permdock --help

Examples
  permdock codemod 0.26 --dry-run
  permdock codemod 0.17 src
  permdock codemod config --prune --check

Side effects  rewrite
Docs  https://permdock.com/docs/cli/codemod
